D2-568.q: Prompt ka kaunsa hissa model ko batata hai ke jawab ki tarteeb kaisi ho, maslan table ki soorat mein?
opts: Output format ki hidayat
Deployment ka naam
Request ke URL mein API version
Azure region
D2-568.exp: Output format ki hidayat, jaise 'In columns wali table do', jawab ki tarteeb tay karti hai. Deployment ka naam, API version aur region technical settings hain jo jawab ke content ki shakal nahi banatin.

D2-569.q: Prompts ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Prompts ka jawabon ki hifazat par koi asar nahi hota.
System message model ko bata sakta hai ke usay kya nahi karna.
Mutalliqa context shamil karne se ghare hue jawabon ka imkan kam hota hai.
D2-569.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: system message mein hifazati hidayaat, content filters ke saath, bachao ki tahon mein se ek hain. Doosre ka Haan: pabandiyan system messages ka aam hissa hain. Teesre ka Haan: model ko mutalliqa facts par ground karne se hallucinations kam hoti hain.

D2-570.q: Har maqsad ko us hidayat se milayein jo usay hasil karti hai. Har hidayat ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
targets: 'Zyada se zyada teen jumlon mein jawab do.'
'Agar yaqeen na ho to kaho ke tumhein nahi pata.'
'Sirf Contoso products ke sawalon ke jawab do.'
D2-570.exp: Jumlon ki had jawab mukhtasar rakhti hai, daire ka usool assistant ko mauzu par rakhta hai, 'mujhe nahi pata' kehne ki ijazat andaze rokti hai, aur lehje ki hidayat andaz tay karti hai. Deployment aur region ki settings code mein hoti hain aur prompt ka hissa nahi.

D2-571.q: Prompts mein ghair bharosemand text sambhalne ke baare mein jumla mukammal karein.
D2-571.tpl: Jab prompt mein users ya documents ka ghair bharosemand text ho to usay {0} mein band karein aur model se kahein ke usay {1} samjhe.
D2-571.exp: Delimiters theek dikhate hain ke ghair bharosemand content kahan shuru aur kahan khatam hota hai, aur model se ye kehna ke usay instructions nahi balke data samjhe, prompt injection ka khatra kam karta hai. Emojis aur capital letters content ko alag nahi karte, aur text ko instructions ya code samajhna wohi hai jo hamlawar chahte hain.

D2-572.q: Classification prompt se milne wale labels ko yaksan banane mein kaunsi tabdeeli sab se zyada madad karti hai?
opts: Temperature barhana
Prompt se tamam misaalein hatana
Labels ki list dena aur theek ek maangna
System message mein ghair mutalliqa text shamil karna
D2-572.exp: Ijazat wale labels batane aur theek ek maangne se outputs tay shuda set mein rehte hain, jis se code ke liye istemal aasan hota hai. Zyada temperature randomness barhata hai, misaalein hatane se rahnumai khatam hoti hai, aur ghair mutalliqa text model ki tawajjo hatata hai.

D2-573.q: Aap ki banayi hui deployment chat playground mein nazar nahi aa rahi. Sab se pehle kya check karna chahiye?
opts: Portal ka color theme aur us ki zaban
Browser ka font size
Aap ke computer ka time zone
Ke aap ne sahi project khola hai
D2-573.exp: Deployments resource ka hissa hoti hain aur us ke projects ke zariye istemal hoti hain, is liye sab se aam wajah doosre project mein hona hai. Theme, font size aur time zone ka deployments ki list par asar nahi.

D2-574.q: Deployments ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Model deploy karne se agent nahi banta; agents alag se banane parte hain.
Har deployment ka resource ke andar apna naam hota hai.
Aap ek hi project mein alag alag models deploy kar sakte hain.
D2-574.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: agents alag se bante hain aur phir deployment istemal karte hain. Doosre ka Haan: apps ke call karte waqt deployment ki pehchan us ke naam se hoti hai. Teesre ka Haan: project kai models istemal kar sakta hai, maslan chat model aur embedding model.

D2-575.q: Ek legal team chahti hai ke ek deployment tashaddud wale content ko default se zyada sakhti se block kare. Kya karna chahiye?
opts: Temperature kam karna
Zyada sakht had wala custom content filter lagana
Resource ko sakht qawaneen wale region mein le jana
Zyada bara model istemal karna
D2-575.exp: Content filter configurations har nuqsan ki category ke liye severity threshold tay karti hain aur deployments par lagti hain, is liye zyada sakht configuration sirf isi par lag sakti hai. Temperature, region aur model ka size ye nahi badalte ke safety system kya block kare.

D2-576.q: Foundry portal mein kaam karne ke baare mein jumla mukammal karein.
D2-576.tpl: Aap deployment ko {0} mein azmate hain aur us ki quality {1} se napte hain.
D2-576.exp: Chat playground haath se jaldi tests ke liye hai, aur evaluations test dataset par quality napti hain. Activity log aur billing page prompts nahi bhejte, aur Azure Policy aur DNS records governance aur networking ke features hain.

D2-577.q: Generative AI app release karne se pehle evaluations chalane ki kaunsi TEEN achhi wajuhaat hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Deployment ka quota khud-ba-khud barhana
Numainda test data par quality napna
Model ke weights badalna
Ek hi data par prompt ke do versions ka muqabla karne ke liye
Jawabon mein hifazat ke khatre dhoondna
D2-577.exp: Evaluations test data par quality napti hain, safety ke khatre dhoondti hain aur prompt ke do versions ko muqable ke qabil banati hain, aur ye sab asli users par asar se pehle. Woh quota nahi barhatin, aur model ke weights kabhi nahi badaltin.

D2-578.q: Foundry SDK istemal karne wale Python chat client mein sab se pehle kaunsa object banate hain?
D2-578.exp: AIProjectClient Foundry project se jurta hai, aur usi se OpenAI-compatible client milta hai jo models call karta hai. Baqi classes Speech, Vision aur Language SDKs ki hain aur chat client ka shuruati qadam nahi.

D2-579.q: Responses aur Chat Completions APIs ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Chat Completions conversation ko service par khud-ba-khud mehfooz karta hai.
Responses API token usage batata hai, jab ke Chat Completions nahi batata.
previous_response_id dene par Responses API conversation jari rakhta hai.
D2-579.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: Chat Completions stateless hai, is liye app history khud bhejti hai. Doosre ka Nahi: dono tokens ki tadad wala usage object deti hain. Teesre ka Haan: previous_response_id nayi request ko pehle ke context se jorta hai.

D2-580.q: Chat client ke har kaam ko us code se milayein jo usay karta hai. Code ki har line ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Models call karne ke liye client lena
D2-580.exp: Credential ke saath AIProjectClient project se jurta hai, get_openai_client() model calls ke liye client deta hai, responses.create() prompt bhejta hai, aur output_text print karne se jawab nazar aata hai. SpeechConfig Speech SDK ka hissa hai aur text chat client mein nahi aata.

D2-581.q: Chhote se chat client ka Python code mukammal karein.
D2-581.exp: DefaultAzureCredential koi argument nahi leta aur Microsoft Entra identity khud dhoondta hai, aur responses.create() input deployment ko bhejta hai. AzureKeyCredential ko key chahiye, SpeechConfig speech ke liye hai, aur generate aur analyze Responses API ke methods nahi.

D2-582.q: User itna lamba document paste karta hai ke request model ki context window se bara ho jata hai. Chat client ko isay kaise sambhalna chahiye?
opts: Wahi request dobara bhejna jab tak model document qubool na kare
Temperature barhana
Deployment ka naam badal kar request phir bhejna
Error pakar kar bhejne se pehle text chhota karna
D2-582.exp: Context window se bari requests nakaam hoti hain, is liye client ko error sambhal kar input kam karna chahiye, maslan user se keh kar, kaat kar, chunks bana kar ya khulasa kar ke. Wahi request dobara bhejne se phir nakaam hogi, aur temperature ya deployment ke naam had nahi badalte.

D2-583.q: responses.create() ko aam taur par kaunsi DO values dete hain? Har sahi jawab hal ka ek hissa hai.
opts: tenant_id, jis mein project ki directory ho
model, jis mein deployment ka naam ho
input, jis mein prompt ya messages hon
quota, jis mein tokens ki had ho
D2-583.exp: Responses API ki call ko model, yani aap ki deployment ka naam, aur jawab dene ke liye input chahiye; instructions jaisi ikhtiyari settings shamil ho sakti hain. Region, tenant aur quota request ke parameters nahi.

D2-584.q: Production mein ek chat client ko kabhi kabhi 500 ya 503 server errors milti hain. Usay kya karna chahiye?
opts: Backoff ke saath dobara koshish aur message dikhana
Deployment delete kar ke dobara banana
Logging band karna
Users se kehna ke page refresh karte rahein
D2-584.exp: Kabhi kabhar ki server errors aam taur par aarzi hoti hain, is liye backoff ke saath dobara koshish aksar kamyab hoti hai, aur masla rahe to wazeh message users ki madad karta hai. Deployment delete karne ya logging band karne se halat bigarti hai, aur baar baar refresh karne se kuch theek hue baghair load barhta hai.

D2-585.q: Kya shamil karna lazmi hai taake agent aap ke upload kiye hue documents mein talash kar sake?
opts: Bara font
Naya Azure region
File search tool
Stop sequence
D2-585.exp: File search tool upload kiye hue documents ko vector store mein index karta hai aur agent ko mutalliqa hisse nikalne deta hai. Fonts, regions aur stop sequences ka documents mein talash se koi taalluq nahi.

D2-586.q: Agents ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Tools ke baghair bhi agent chat mein apni instructions par chal sakta hai.
Agent knowledge tools aur action tools ko jor sakta hai.
Mazeed tools shamil karne se agent zyada accurate ho jata hai.
D2-586.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: akele model aur instructions se conversations chal sakti hain. Doosre ka Haan: maslan jawabon ke liye file search aur amal ke liye function calling. Teesre ka Nahi: ghair zaroori tools se tool ka intikhab uljh sakta hai, is liye sirf woh shamil karein jo agent ko chahiye.

D2-587.q: Agent ki har zaroorat ko us tool se milayein jo usay pura karta hai. Har tool ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Upload ki hui file ke numbers par hisab karna
Product manual se sawalon ke jawab dena
Inventory API mein stock ki live miqdar check karna
D2-587.exp: File ke data par hisab ke liye code interpreter chahiye, manual se jawab ke liye file search, aur stock ki live miqdar ke liye OpenAPI tool ya function ke zariye inventory API ki call. Image generation tasveerein banata hai aur in mein se kisi zaroorat ke liye munasib nahi.

D2-588.ctx: Ek agent ke paas send_email function hai. Jab users mubham tareeqay se request karte hain to woh kabhi kabhi ghalat logon ko emails bhej deta hai.
D2-588.q: Sab se behtar tabdeeli kya hai?
opts: Agent ki instructions hatana
Temperature barhana
Agent ko addresses dhoondne ke mazeed tools dena
Agent ke liye lazmi karna ke user se recipient ki tasdeeq kare
D2-588.exp: Hassas amal se pehle tasdeeq ka qadam, jo instructions mein likha ho ya approval ke taur par lagu ho, aisi ghaltiyan rokta hai jinhein wapas karna mushkil hota hai. Instructions hatana, randomness barhana ya ghair mutalliqa tools dena ghalat emails ka imkan barhata.

D2-589.q: Python client se agent ko user ka message kaunsi call bhejti hai?
D2-589.exp: Agent se jure hue client ke saath responses.create() user ka input bhejta hai aur agent ka jawab deta hai. Deployments ki list lena, speech synthesizer banana aur Image Analysis call karna agent se baat nahi karte.

D2-590.q: Agent clients ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Client agent ka jawab response object se parhta hai.
Agents sirf Foundry portal se istemal ho sakte hain.
Chat sessions ek hi conversation istemal karte hain jo client apne users ke liye ek baar banata hai.
D2-590.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: jawab ka text response ke output_text mein hota hai. Doosre ka Nahi: apps agents ko SDKs ya REST API se call karti hain. Teesre ka Nahi: har session ki alag conversation se har chat ki history alag rehti hai.

D2-591.q: Woh Python code mukammal karein jo helpdesk agent ke saath conversation shuru kar ke pehla message bhejta hai.
D2-591.exp: conversations.create() nayi conversation shuru karta hai, aur us ka id responses.create() ko diya jata hai taake message usi conversation mein jaye. delete conversation hatata hai, list shuru karne ke liye nahi, aur name aur text conversation ki pehchan nahi.

D2-592.q: Kaunsi DO zimmedariyan agent ki definition ke bajaye client app ki hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Agent ki instructions aur us ke jawabon ke usool
Agent ke tools
Agent ka model
Ye janna ke kaunsi conversation kis user ki hai
Agent ka jawab user interface mein dikhana
D2-592.exp: Client users, un ki conversation IDs aur jawab dikhane ka tareeqa sambhalta hai. Instructions, tools aur model agent ki definition ka hissa hain jo Foundry mein mehfooz hoti hai aur har client ke liye mushtarka hai.

D2-593.q: Agent bana kar us se ek sawal poochne wale script ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: responses.create() call kar ke output_text print karein
Agent se jura hua OpenAI client lein
Model aur instructions ke saath agent version banayein
D2-593.exp: Script project se jurta hai, agent version banata hai, us agent se jura client leta hai aur phir sawal bhejta hai. Models Foundry mein chalte hain, is liye koi weights upload nahi karne parte.
